description: Is a known-vulnerable version of this package reached by the project's own code? Without symbol it answers at dependency grain: reachable is true when an affected version is imported by a first-party file, with the advisories and importing files. With symbol it answers at symbol grain: reachable is true when an EXTRACTED call path runs from the project's code to that function in the package, and returns the path. Use it to check a fix: after upgrading, the package should read reachable: false.

ecosystem.description: npm, PyPI or Go: disambiguates a name used in more than one ecosystem.

package.description: Package name as the ecosystem spells it (lodash, @scope/pkg, jinja2, github.com/x/y).

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

service.description: Only this service (its name or service: node id).

symbol.description: A function in the package (template, Range.test) for a symbol-grain answer. Needs the package's code in the graph, which NEAT extracts for versions with a known advisory.

version.description: Only this resolved version. Omit for every version the project resolves.

name: is_reachable
